title: Tenant destruction keeps files of held rows
detail: The fileRef destroy hook skips the fileRefs listed in heldFileRefIds, and the files prefix sweep keeps their bytes. Without a configured file provider, the retention cleanup still removes the held fileRef rows after keepFor and logs that no bytes could be deleted, so the tenant does not stay in destroyHeld forever.

title: Tenant destroy hooks make progress even when the deadline already passed
detail: The chunked migration takes a minBatches option and the file destroy hooks process one chunk per tick, so a slow list call no longer makes every run time out empty.

title: The orphan-derivative sweep keeps derivatives whose original still exists in storage
sweepOrphanedDerivativesJob takes the raw DbConnection as a third argument; the job declares escapeHatch (fw#2914).
detail: JobContext.db is now a tenant-filtered TenantDb. The sweep checks fileRef owners of every tenant, so its registration declares `escapeHatch` and passes `ctx.db.unsafeRaw(reason)` to `sweepOrphanedDerivativesJob(payload, ctx, db)`. Without the raw runner, the foreign-tenant owner lookup would be narrowed away and every derivative would look orphaned.
migration: Direct callers of the exported `sweepOrphanedDerivativesJob` pass the raw `DbConnection` as the third argument. Apps that only mount the feature need no change.
